text: 因编造、传播虚假信息，证监会对证券行业原分析师宗建树、马星瑞分别下发行政处罚决定书，其中宗建树被处以5年市场禁入的措施，马星瑞被罚款30万元。同日，湖北证监局亦对两名分析师原所在机构长江证券采取责令改正的行政监管措施。对此，相关机构回应称，对任何违法违规行为持“零容忍”态度，已对涉事员工开展批评教育并采取相应处罚措施，目前涉事员工已从公司离职，后续将进一步提升全员合规意识，坚决杜绝类似问题再次发生。（证券时报）
text_en: For fabricating and disseminating false information, the CSRC issued administrative penalty decisions respectively to former securities industry analysts Zong Jianshu and Ma Xingrui, among which Zong Jianshu was subject to a 5-year market ban, and Ma Xingrui was fined RMB 300,000. On the same day, the Hubei Securities Regulatory Bureau also took an administrative regulatory measure ordering correction against Changjiang Securities, the institution where the two analysts formerly worked. In response, the relevant institution said it maintains a "zero tolerance" attitude toward any illegal and non-compliant acts, has criticized and educated the employees involved and taken corresponding punitive measures, and that the employees involved have now left the company; it will further enhance compliance awareness among all employees and resolutely prevent similar problems from recurring. (Securities Times)
